prompts: Night Omani gold souk architectural concept; cream weathered flat-roof two-storey strips, Arabic signs, empty parking, no vehicles/people.
Seamless warm ivory aged cement stucco base color, fine sandy grain, neutral flat diffuse lighting, no objects/shadows/writing.
Four full-width sign strips: مجوهرات الياقوت / AL YAQOOT JEWELLERY; عطور البخور / AL BUKHOOR PERFUMES; خياطة النخيل / AL NAKHEEL TAILORING; سوق الذهب / GOLD MARKET. Lightly worn enamel.

Transparent RGBA grime decal atlas: subtle brown-gray vertical rain/dust runoff streaks, four varied clusters, top-edge deposits tapering downward, pale warm ochre-gray, no wall/base color/objects/text/shadows. Weathered Omani ivory plaster, age and dust rather than black mold.

Orthographic transparent RGBA accumulation of genuinely shattered colorless architectural safety glass: hundreds of small irregular translucent granules and angular chips, a few larger thin triangular fragments, dense center tapering to sparse edges. Flat soft neutral studio illumination, no floor/frame/wall/container/text/solid background or large baked highlights; no green, foam, snow, paper or diamonds. Used only as a lit fine-debris contact layer beneath real geometry.
derivation: Original generated images preserved. Plaster periodic/smooth edge correction; four sign crops retain 4:1 aspect. Five additional sign bitmaps use shaped Arabic/English typography. New art imported with mipmaps, 1024px cap and Android ASTC 6x6.
